description: This file defines the ConciergeConfig interface, specifying configuration methods for the Concierge service, including enforcement, caches, aggregation, and cleanup configurations. It extends several other config interfaces and includes annotations related to immutability.

classes.name: ConciergeConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for the Concierge service, including enforcement, caching, aggregation, and persistence cleanup, extending multiple base configuration interfaces.

methods.name: getEnforcementConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for Concierge's enforcement behavior.

methods.name: getCachesConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for Concierge's caches.

methods.name: getThingsAggregatorConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for Concierge's thing aggregation.

methods.name: getPersistenceCleanupConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for persistence cleanup actions.
